sn35.77:1.3: The eye is suffering, Rādha. You should give up desire for it.
sn35.77:1.7: This eye contact … or neutral, that too is suffering. You should give up desire for it …
sn35.77:1.12: The pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on mind contact is also suffering. You should give up desire for it.
sn35.77:1.13: Rādha, you should give up desire for what is suffering.”
